text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the autumn Tenno Sho—the ultimate medium-distance race for classic and senior-year racers.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I'm telling you, Tamamo Cross is gonna win today! She's gonna pull off the first Tenno Sweep of all time! Hoooo boy, do I wanna see history made with my very own eyes!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's definitely Oguri Cap's day! This is the Beast of Kasamatsu we're talking about here! Not even Tamamo Cross stands a chance!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The heck? Race hasn't even started yet and the air's already cracklin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: With this much pressure built up, Tokyo Racecourse is gonna blow like a cork when I win. Now that'd be a sight.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No, that'd be problematic. We wouldn't be able to race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No, ya dummy, that was just a figure of speech! Quit lookin' like da sky's started fallin'!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't want anything to happen to the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh?! C'mon, you were rarin' to go already without all this metaphor nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hit me with yer best shot, Oguri Cap. Da White Lightnin' of Naniwa's gonna put ya in yer place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (…The atmosphere is suffocating. This pressure must be down to the presence of the other racers—they're the mightiest of the moment…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (The race has yet to begin and I can barely contain my excitement. I want to get a taste of their prowess as soon as I possibly can!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A gathering of the moment's greatest on the ultimate stage… Here I come.
